title: BluePeak Office Equipment — Company Overview
text: BluePeak Office Equipment is a fictional office equipment supplier founded in 2018 and based in Austin, Texas. The company sells printers, scanners, and office chairs to small businesses. Customer support is available on weekdays from 9 AM to 5 PM Central Time at 1-800-555-0142.

title: BluePeak Product Catalog and Price List 2026
text: The BluePeak BP-100 laser printer costs $299 and prints 25 pages per minute. The BluePeak ScanPro 200 document scanner costs $449 and scans 40 pages per minute. The BluePeak ErgoFlex office chair costs $259 and supports up to 300 pounds. Prices include sales tax and are valid through December 31, 2026.

title: BluePeak Warranty and Shipping Policy
text: All BluePeak printers carry a 2-year warranty and all scanners carry a 1-year warranty. Office chairs are covered by a 5-year warranty on the frame. Orders over $500 ship free within the continental United States; smaller orders pay a flat shipping fee of $19. Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days.
